native_init: Keep existing Rademacher factors. INACTIVE_INITIALIZATION_COMBINATION is NOT implemented.
tied_views: PV1/V1 one native Body(members=1) executed over4 view contexts; ALL parameters/biases/factors tied. Never silently use private bias rows for PV1.
scan_maps: One shared W_u,W_a,W_o,b_u,b_a in SW4/C4/R4; all private per WI4 body; all tied across views in each PV1/V1 single. No private scan factors or biases.
C4: Same operator as SW4 but every private native route uses tour0.
R4: Reset prior state at every token; s=q=(1-a)u, preserving learned maps,parameter count,node readout,and native source loss.
implementation: Custom first-order autograd affine doubling with manual reverse adjoint, O(MLh) scan storage and paid O(MLh logL) work. No per-node CUDA loop or eager level tape.
source_only: Root separately owns finite admission, numerical checks,complete input binding,execution and publication. No optional checks or new job from scientist/preparer.
